source: Deep discovery's sensitivity judgments and hedgeability screen (spec §7.1 steps 3 and 5): for each driver-event pair, direction, mechanism, magnitude band, lag band and conditionality; for each exposure, whether an authoritative observable tracks the loss, whether the client could influence it, and whether a listed market is close. Bands are closed sets so code maps them into intervals, never midpoints (addendum A04 §4.1). Ours, November 1, in spec §7.1's words.
